$comment: Each mutant removes one guard of the refresh write barrier (kind guard) or a guard that is defense in depth at these bounds (kind survivor, expect survives). spec edits a copy of the model and TLC must report expect; code makes the same edit to the implementation, and each named test must fail under it and pass without it. Run: bun scripts/spec/mutants.ts refresh-barrier [--spec-only|--code-only] [--only <id>]. See spec/tla/README.md.

await declarePersistenceProtocol(tx);

edits.after:
const [held] = await tx.executeRaw('SELECT 1 FROM persistence_worktree_refreshes WHERE id=$1::uuid AND released_at IS NULL FOR NO KEY UPDATE', [row.deferred_refresh_id]);
      await declarePersistenceProtocol(tx);

mutants.reason: defense in depth in the model, whose only consumer claims through claimableWriteSql; the trigger stops an older binary's claim, which the model leaves out, and the named test pins it

tests.filter: a claim without the barrier declaration cannot move a deferred row

mutants.title: fenceAndMerge does not re-count the drain under its locks
mutants.reason: defense in depth at these bounds: every admission after the refresh row exists is deferred, so no queued work can appear between the drain poll and the fence

mutants.title: a claim ignores the refresh fence
mutants.reason: defense in depth at these bounds: under the fence every queued row has drained and every new admission is deferred to the unreleased refresh, so nothing is claimable

mutants.title: a claim does not declare the protocol (brain row FOR SHARE)
mutants.reason: defense in depth at these bounds: the fence's drain count and the claim's own request-row lock already order a claim against the fence

mutants.title: a deferred write's replay does not re-authorize it
mutants.reason: defense in depth: publication re-authorizes every write (publication-skips-reauth)
